Paragraph: The work of a man who is unattached to the modes of material nature and who is fully situated in transcendental knowledge merges entirely into transcendence.
Situation/Problem_Faced: How to prevent daily actions from generating psychological strain and material entanglement.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'The work of a man who is unattached to the modes of material nature and who is fully situated in transcendental knowledge merges entirely into transcendence.'
Outcome/Resolution: When action is performed with spiritual wisdom and non-attachment, its binding effects completely dissolve.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Detached Execution: Performing responsibilities thoroughly without emotional attachment to results
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Cognitive Liberation: Viewing life through deep wisdom to break free from reactive habits
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Purpose-Driven Action: Converting routine work into a self-transcending, sacrificial endeavor

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Gata-sangasya (Free from attachment to material modes)
Jnana-vasthita-cetasah (Mind firmly established in spiritual knowledge)
Yajnayacaratah karma (Actions performed as a spirit of sacrifice)
Samagram praviliyate (Actions completely dissolve into transcendence)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Actions done in divine wisdom and sacrifice leave no karmic residue, merging into pure spirit.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Anchoring actions in higher purpose prevents burnout and keeps external forces from controlling inner peace.
